acceptance_scope: Same core motion criteria as prior reviews; shoreline naturalism is assessed separately and remains below the reference quality.

findings.evidence: Both scenes/profiles show white damage flash at.1/.2 and return to gray by.4. Compact orange impact differs from large fireball at1 second; fireball disperses by1.5.
Connected trail follows turn and older ends broaden/fade at2/3. Coast explosion plume at1.5 disperses by2; no opaque obstruction of player. Fine grain and separated distal traces remain.
Fleet wakes remain attached and taper across all sampled translations. Rounded repeating bands remain conspicuous but no rectangular detachment is seen.
Fleet initial recenter and coast scrolling preserve central player tracking through turn. Cyan ring remains centered; no sampled jump or ring detachment.
HUD, minimap and buttons remain readable in both scenes and profiles. Escort behind Bomb at3 leaves label readable; coast action does not cover controls.

Longer wisps remain aligned with coast while their coverage/visibility changes through samples: crests are prominent from0–1.5 and mostly faint at2/3. No detached shoreline block or geometry pop visible.

Long soft tapered crests improve substantially on thin regular dashes. They still form narrow isolated streaks over a smooth translucent shallows band, without broad irregular foam breakup or textured wash on the sand. This remains a material/effects polish gap, not a new continuity blocker.
findings.recommendation: Vary crest width and lateral offset, use irregular overlapping patches and fade through uneven foam breakup rather than fading entire long strokes.

nonblocking: Shoreline naturalness remains incomplete despite better temporal variation.
Smoke is grainy and wakes repeat scalloped bands.
Ocean ripples repeat and grass/sand/deck materials remain schematic.
Player ring identifies location but does not resolve overlapping aircraft silhouettes.
limits: All36 supplied PNGs inspected independently, timestamps/events read. No source/key/other judges inspected. Sparse stills do not establish continuous playback smoothness or actual phone FPS. Acceptance is not material parity.
